_doc: Emerald's gTileset_Sootopolis labelled by eye (emerald_ch10 2026-10-12; wins over carry_gTileset_Sootopolis.json). Only LAYOUT_SOOTOPOLIS_CITY_LEGENDS_BATTLE uses these: the lake as rough water (0x290 METATILE_Sootopolis_RoughWater, MB_OCEAN_WATER; 0x2b0-0x2c7 the 4x6 rough patches of SetRoughWater) and its rough shores, roof and cliff edges. Each takes the class of the tile it replaces in LAYOUT_SOOTOPOLIS_CITY (the same block of both layouts); the rough water's ocean behaviour draws it as sea (b2tools/terrain/water.py look) where the calm lake (MB_POND_WATER) is a pond.
